$comment: Cover palettes and compositions for scripts/cover-style.mjs. Each daily cover must use a palette not used by the previous 4 posts and a composition not used by the previous 3. 'light' palettes have a pale background; at least one in every four covers should be light.

palettes.name: oxblood
palettes.mood: Dark red and gold, courts, power, luxury

palettes.name: teal-noir
palettes.mood: Deep teal with coral, ocean, labs

palettes.name: blueprint
palettes.mood: Cobalt drafting paper, white lines, yellow marks

palettes.name: paper
palettes.mood: Cream paper, ink drawing, rust and blue

palettes.name: arctic
palettes.mood: Pale ice, cold, clean, coral signal

palettes.name: mint
palettes.mood: Soft mint and lilac, friendly, consumer

compositions.name: neon-scene
compositions.how: Glowing objects on a dark stage with a perspective floor grid and soft blur halos.

compositions.name: isometric-diorama
compositions.how: A small 3D-ish scene on a 30-degree isometric grid: boxes, buildings, machines with flat shading and long shadows. No glow.

compositions.name: flat-poster
compositions.how: Three to five big flat shapes in solid colours, no gradients, hard edges, generous negative space. Swiss poster feel.

compositions.name: blueprint-linework
compositions.how: Thin outline drawing of the object with dashed construction lines, dimension ticks (no numbers) and a faint grid. One or two filled accents.

compositions.name: cross-section
compositions.how: The object cut open to show its insides: layers, chambers, components, with a clean cut face.

compositions.name: silhouette-horizon
compositions.how: Dark silhouettes (skyline, people, machines) against a large gradient sky with one big sun or moon disc.

compositions.name: macro-closeup
compositions.how: One object fills most of the frame, cropped at the edges, strong directional light, visible texture.

compositions.name: paper-cutout
compositions.how: Layered paper shapes stacked front to back with soft drop shadows between layers, like a diorama made of card.

compositions.name: collage-grid
compositions.how: A tiled grid or mosaic of many small related objects, with one tile broken, highlighted or missing.

compositions.name: split-frame
compositions.how: The canvas split in two halves (diagonal or vertical) showing two sides: before/after, two companies, old/new.

compositions.name: top-down-map
compositions.how: Bird's-eye view: a map, routes, pins, borders or a floor plan, with one route or region highlighted.

compositions.name: bauhaus-geometric
compositions.how: The subject built from circles, triangles and bars in a strict geometric arrangement, slight paper grain, no outlines.
